title: FellowFinder Light
body:
## 🧭 FellowFinder Light

**An ultra-lightweight mod for sensing teammates beyond your visual range.**

**专注超视距队友感知的超轻量模组。**

Even when friends are out of sight, you can still feel each other's direction. No maps, no waypoints — just a clean compass bar that tells you where your friends are, how far away they are, and whether they're above or below you.

---

### ✨ Features | 功能

- 🧭 **Compass Bar HUD** | **罗盘条 HUD** — Displays other players' direction, height arrow (↑/↓/I), name, and distance at the top of the screen
- 🎨 **UUID-Based Fixed Colors** | **UUID 固定颜色** — Each player gets a unique, consistent color generated from their UUID
- 👻 **Vanilla Visibility Rules** | **遵循原版可见性规则** — Sneaking, invisible, spectator, and head-covered players are automatically hidden
- 📡 **LAN & Server Broadcast** | **局域网与服务器广播** — Host/server auto-broadcasts positions every 2 seconds for beyond-visual-range tracking
- 🪶 **Ultra Lightweight** | **极致轻量** — Minimal performance impact
- ⌨️ **F1 Auto-Hide** | **F1 一键隐藏** — Auto-hides with the vanilla HUD

### 🔧 New in 26.1.2 | 26.1.2 新增

- **Fabric + NeoForge Dual Support** | **同时支持 Fabric 和 NeoForge**
- **3-Tier Broadcast Mode** | **3 档广播模式** — All / Friends Only / None
- **3 Distance Display Modes** | **3 种距离显示模式** — Horizontal distance / Straight-line distance / Hidden
- **Cross-Dimension Conversion** | **跨维度坐标换算** — Nether ↔ Overworld auto conversion (disabled by default), distances marked with `[17.3m]` brackets
- **Local Blacklist** | **本地黑名单** — Block specific players, or use `ALL` to block everyone
- **Auto-Fade Animation** | **自动上隐动画** — Compass bar smoothly fades out when no players are nearby
- **Adjustable Y Position & Display Angle** | **可调 Y 轴位置和显示角度** — Customize via Mod Menu (Fabric) or config file
- **Test Mode** | **测试模式** — Place a test marker 2 blocks in front to preview and adjust compass position
- **Full Display Mode** | **完全显示模式** — Bypass all visibility filters when needed

### 🖥️ Server Plugin Addon | 服务端插件加成

This mod can work with the **FellowFinder Light server plugin** (Paper / Lophine) for an enhanced experience. Download it on Modrinth: [https://modrinth.com/plugin/fellowfinder-light]

本模组可配合 **FellowFinder Light 服务端插件**（Paper / Lophine）获得更完整的体验。在 Modrinth 下载：[https://modrinth.com/plugin/fellowfinder-light]

| Without Plugin | With Plugin |
|:---|:---|
| All players are visible by default | Players must mutually agree to share positions |
| No permission control | `/ffl share/accept/cancel` commands |
| Basic broadcast only | AFK detection, TPS throttling, persistent pairing |
| Chat-based only for non-mod users | Cross-dimension friend tracking via compass |

**No mod? No problem.** Players without the mod can still use `/ffl` commands, they just won't see the compass bar. Everyone benefits from the plugin's location system.

**没装模组？没关系。** 没装模组的玩家也能用 `/ffl` 指令互相申请位置共享，只是看不到罗盘条而已。装了模组的玩家则可以在罗盘条上实时看到好友位置。

### 📥 Installation | 安装方法

1. Download the `.jar` from the version page
2. Place it in `.minecraft/mods/`
3. Ensure **Fabric Loader** (≥0.16.0) + **Fabric API** (Fabric) or **NeoForge** (NeoForge) are installed
4. For Fabric: install **Mod Menu** for the config GUI
5. Launch the game

For the server plugin, visit the (https://modrinth.com/plugin/fellowfinderlightplugin)

### 🎮 Supported Versions | 支持版本

| Minecraft | Mod Loader | Status |
|:----------|:-----------|:-------|

| 26.1.2 | NeoForge | ✅ Released |
